sloka: अन्कोलाः च कुरण्टाः च पूर्णकाः पारिभद्रकाः ।चूताः पाटलयः च अपि कोविदाराः च पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-८०॥
transliteration: ankolāḥ ca kuraṇṭāḥ ca pūrṇakāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ ।cūtāḥ pāṭalayaḥ ca api kovidārāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-80॥

translations.english: 'There are trees like ankola, kuranta, churnaka, paribhadraka, mango, patali, kovidara, muchukunda, arjuna, ketaka, uddalaka, shirisha, shimshupa and shava, all in full bloom on the mountain peaks.
